business.name: Keyline Home Care
business.tagline: We look after your home while you are away, with a photo report after every visit.

hours.time: Any time for storms and alarms

services.name: Weekly house checks
services.description: Doors, windows, water, power and mail, with photos sent to you.

services.name: Garden and lawn care
services.description: Mowing, edges and watering so the place never looks empty.

services.name: Storm and alarm call-outs
services.description: We go round when the weather turns or the alarm goes off.

about.story: Keyline started when friends kept asking us to keep an eye on their places over winter. Today we look after more than forty homes around Queenstown, and every visit ends with photos sent straight to the owner.

reviews.quote: We were overseas for three months and got photos after every check. Coming home to a tidy garden and no surprises was worth every cent.
reviews.author: Rachel and Tom

reviews.quote: They spotted a leaking tap the first week and had it fixed before it became a problem.
reviews.author: Graham P.

hero.alt: White townhouse with a dark gate and garage
